_readme: Central settings for the Clip Adjustments panel. Edit this file, then hard-refresh the browser (and restart the server). Everything here is optional: a missing or broken value falls back to the built-in default. 'limits' are the allowed range of every control (the server enforces them too). 'defaults' is what a fresh panel starts with. 'systemPresets' are built in and cannot be deleted from the app: add your own entries here (values are the same fields as 'defaults'; leave a field out to keep it unchanged). Presets you save inside the app are stored in your browser and can be deleted. 'aspectRules' ties the aspect-ratio menu to the framing rules (js/shared/framing.js presets).
